summary: The chapter already meets the bar on text, misconceptions and questions; add one figure that shows how an instantaneous dipole forms and induces a dipole in a neighbouring molecule.

improvements.caption: How an instantaneous dipole in one I₂ molecule induces a dipole in a neighbouring I₂ molecule
improvements.where: note, after the paragraph on instantaneous dipole-induced dipole forces
improvements.why: The note describes electron-cloud fluctuation and induction in words only; this figure shows the two-step process (fluctuation, then induction in a neighbour) for I2, which the diagram table cannot draw, and is legible and self-contained.
